observed_or_design_fact: Full Core did not outperform strong-simple governance; the frozen high-budget point estimate was unfavorable
why_it_matters: Structural eligibility did not guarantee numerical replication
v1_1_response: Separate structural qualification from numerical evidence authority and require both
forbidden_overinterpretation: Do not claim the old Full Core already controlled agentic winner selection

observed_or_design_fact: Nearly all Full-Core G0-G6 results passed and only one episode abstained per provider arm
why_it_matters: The benchmark rarely activated structural hard gates while numerical winner risk remained
v1_1_response: Add a distinct numerical authority layer rather than changing G0-G6 semantics
forbidden_overinterpretation: Do not relabel numerical disappointment as a Core gate failure

observed_or_design_fact: A one-shot untouched holdout was a strong comparator
why_it_matters: A genuinely untouched final test already absorbs arbitrary development search for one frozen claim
v1_1_response: Encode a one-shot sufficiency rule and test v1.1 only where reuse/multiple claims/structural mismatch creates additional risk
forbidden_overinterpretation: Do not penalize development search merely to make RIEC appear superior

observed_or_design_fact: Qwen did not show monotonic unsupported-claim inflation across search budgets
why_it_matters: Search volume alone was not a provider-invariant causal driver in the frozen campaign
v1_1_response: Manipulate and audit protected-evidence reuse, claim-family multiplicity and feedback, not budget alone
forbidden_overinterpretation: Do not claim a universal monotonic search-inflation law

why_it_matters: Provider failures can create informative missingness and invalidate replication
v1_1_response: Freeze terminal-status rules, use intention-to-run denominators and require completion-validity criteria
forbidden_overinterpretation: Do not treat completed DeepSeek episodes as confirmatory provider evidence

observed_or_design_fact: The same data were searched by different agents but agent identity was not independent evidence
why_it_matters: Multiple agents can multiply search without adding independent observations
v1_1_response: Use one campaign-wide evidence and search ledger across agents/providers/prompts
forbidden_overinterpretation: Do not count model agreement as data replication

observed_or_design_fact: Holdout-only reduced unsupported claims but sometimes false-blocked true claims
why_it_matters: Maximum blocking is not automatically optimal governance
v1_1_response: Report false claims, false blocking, coverage, regret and evidence cost separately; use a preregistered utility only as secondary
forbidden_overinterpretation: Do not hide safety-coverage trade-offs in one favorable aggregate score

observed_or_design_fact: Structurally admissible routes could still be numerical winners that failed lockbox replication
why_it_matters: A route can pass identity/estimand/deployment checks yet remain selected by noise
v1_1_response: Final effect authority must come from fresh confirmation evidence, not the selected development estimate
forbidden_overinterpretation: Do not promote a development winner's effect size into a confirmatory claim

why_it_matters: Agent policy is part of the search process and may alter both missingness and claim selection
v1_1_response: Replicate the same frozen environment across independently sealed provider arms and prohibit outcome-driven pooling
forbidden_overinterpretation: Do not generalize one economy configuration to a model family
